experience.footer: Your first comparison starts with your catalog.
experience.settingsHint: You can manage your connections later in Settings.
experience.fileRequired: Choose a CSV file to import.

errors.session: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.permissions: We couldn’t access your store. Check its connection and the permissions you granted.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests at once. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.timeout: This is taking longer than expected. Try again in a moment.
errors.service: We couldn’t read the response from the comparison service. Try again. If it keeps happening, contact support.
errors.validation: Check the information you entered and try again.
errors.tooLarge: This file is too large to import. Use a smaller file or split it into separate imports.
errors.emptyCatalog: We couldn’t find any products to import. Check that the file or feed includes product records.
errors.conflict: This store is already connected to another account. Sign in with that account or contact support.
errors.plan: Choose a plan to use this feature.
errors.unavailable: We couldn’t complete this step. Try again. If the problem continues, contact support.
errors.sourceUnavailable: We couldn’t read those product pages. Try the product’s own store page, or add competitors with Search.
errors.noCompetitors: No competitors matched that search. Try a broader brand or product category.
errors.feedUnavailable: We couldn’t read that feed. Check that the address opens a public XML or JSON feed, then try again.

progress.reading: Reading {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} from your catalog

googleShopping.description: An RSS or Atom feed with product fields such as g:title, g:price and g:image_link inside each <item>.

json.description: A list of product records containing title, price, image and url. The list can sit inside a products or items key.
